notes: Kuzo 0.2.7 (trial - not approved under PRO-AIC-0608 C1). Pass B recorded the other way is turned round automatically (said on screen, one click shows it as recorded, logged). A tick reverses the recorded direction for the whole set-up (reason and note, logged, not on the report). Return-pass LF is now read as WINTROS reads it, so the two passes' LF waves sit on top of each other (heads MH 6-26 and MH 22-45 matched). "Align passes" lines pass B up on pass A along the whole rope by itself, shows the match section by section and flags every stretch where the passes differ - display and review aid only. NOT RAW is no longer printed on the client report.
